verdict: Mac causal witness analyzed; observed endpoint/MO-close bias, Windows first-failure cause remains UNKNOWN
interpretation: The original classifier charges a whole excess gap when its END lies in a delayed MO span; synchronous native busy-clear precedes MO close. Equal rounded timestamps permit a heartbeat at the closing callback timestamp to be included.

All-beat intersection bounds include gaps whose end lies OUTSIDE the MO span as well. They may be above or below the original flight metric and are diagnostic only; original verdict/40%/85%/ceiling/count gates were untouched.
Message passive capture-listener stamps occur AFTER native clear by6.9..12.7ms here; these are observer callbacks after the pane handler, not native arrival/worker CPU timestamps.
No worker-page longtask >=50ms was reported; all same-code Mac samples pass. No direct extrapolation to the Windows98/89ms gaps is justified.
boundsDefinition: For a heartbeat [start,end] with excess=max(0,end-start-4), sum its intersections with definite native busy [open.after,close.before] and possible native busy [open.before,close.after]. Conservative excess-in-busy bounds are [max(0,definiteIntersection-4), min(excess,possibleIntersection)]. Diagnostic wall-time bounds, not CPU attribution or replacement verdict. allBeatConservativeBusyExcessBounds additionally takes maxima across ALL original sample heartbeat intervals intersecting native windows, including beats whose end falls outside MO span. This is diagnostic only and may exceed or be below original flight.
